pyramiding_rule: Zero pyramiding into negative floating positions; only scale into positions when the initial trade has moved at least +$8 in profit and stop-loss is locked at breakeven.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Require an order-flow delta/volume-imbalance confirmation candle and a minimum 3-ATR volatility cooldown check before executing any entry on XAUUSD.
profit_harvest_threshold: Scale out 50% of volume at +$10 floating profit and trail the remaining position tightly to capture asymmetric $15 to $30+ runs.
